heading: Today
text: Mostly sunny. Highs from the mid 30s to around 40 north, and low to mid 40s in the south. Light and variable winds.

heading: Tonight
text: Clear to partly cloudy. Clear to partly cloudy. Lows mainly from the mid teens to lower 20s. Winds remaining light and variable.

heading: Thursday
text: Increasing clouds north. Mostly cloudy south, with a rising chance of precipitation mid to late afternoon in the south, of rain in the valleys, and rain or freezing rain at higher elevations. Valley highs in the low to mid 40s. Winds becoming east 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 35 mph late in the south.
